'''Doug Anderson''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[April 2000 Geneva tournament]] on 15 April 2000 with Light Side Mains (starting Obi's Hut), according to Steve Kuperman's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d555">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-18-geneva-illinois-4-15-2000d555/ geneva-illinois-4-15-2000], DeckTech (Steve "Crazy Hermit" Kuperman, 18 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-18-geneva-illinois-4-15-2000d555/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
